_comment: RECONSTRUCTED 2026-11-03 after the original file was lost in the transfer to PSC Bridges-2, which excluded data/. Every field here is either verified against a file on disk today or carried over from a surviving document. Nothing is reconstructed from memory. See bridges2/MISSING_FILES.md.

verified_today: 0_tr143.mp4 re-downloaded from the Mendeley URL in configs/clip_0_tr143.json; sha256 and byte size computed from the file on disk
carried_over_from: README.md: DOI, licence, class table, clip count, train/test split, paper citation
configs/clip_0_tr143.json: download URL and expected sha256
STATUS.md: the probed media metadata of 0_tr143.mp4
_reconstruction.lost_and_not_reconstructed: The original file recorded three class-0 clips downloaded during Stage 1 selection. Only 0_tr143.mp4 is recoverable: its sha256 survived in configs/clip_0_tr143.json. The filenames and sha256 of the other two are lost, and are NOT guessed here. The Stage 1 claim that 0_tr143.mp4 was the best of three cannot currently be re-checked.

dataset.title: Video Dataset for Safe and Unsafe Behaviours

paper.title: Unsafe-Net: YOLO v4 and ConvLSTM based computer vision system for real-time detection of unsafe behaviours in workplace
paper._availability_note: The data-availability statement covers the dataset only. The Mendeley record contains 691 .mp4 files and no model artefacts. This is why Stage 5, the classifier-guided gate, is blocked.

privacy.note: The clips show identifiable factory workers who consented to the authors' research study, not to redistribution by third parties. CC BY 4.0 permits redistribution legally; this project chooses not to.
controls: the clip is fetched from Mendeley rather than carried in the repository

downloaded._selection_reason: The violating worker is large, about 40% of frame height, unoccluded and centre-frame, with the empty green walkway visible in the same shot.

downloaded_but_lost_from_this_record._note: Two further class-0 clips were downloaded and inspected during Stage 1 selection. Their filenames and sha256 were only ever recorded in this file and did not survive the transfer. Recovering them means re-downloading from the Mendeley record and re-identifying which two were compared. No placeholder entries are written here, because a fabricated hash is worse than a missing one.
